Name: qryCosts_ByFiscalYear
Sql:
SELECT psc.FiscalYear, Sum(csp.AnnualEstCost) AS TotalCost
FROM tblProviders AS p INNER JOIN (tblProviderServiceCatalog AS psc INNER JOIN tblClientServicePlan AS csp ON psc.ProviderServiceCatalogID = csp.ProviderServiceCatalogID) ON p.ProviderID = psc.ProviderID
WHERE (((csp.Status)<>"Cancelled"))
GROUP BY psc.FiscalYear;
